provisions.heading: Supplies made free of charge.
provisions.relevanceReason: Uncategorised by heading/body keyword match; needs human review to determine relevance.
provisions.excerpt:
21
.— Anything which is a supply of goods by
virtue of
section
19
(1)(f), (g)
or
(h)
shall be deemed, for
the purposes of this Act, to have been effected for
consideration in the course or furtherance of the business
concerned except—

(
a
) a gift of goods made in the course or
furtherance of the business (otherwise than as one forming
part of a series or succession of gifts made to the same
person) the cost of which to the donor does not exceed a sum
specified for that purpose in regulations, or

(
b
) the gift, in reasonable quantity, to the actual
or potential customer, of industrial samples in a form not
ordinarily available for sale to the public.
